# Skill: Propose Architecture

## Procedure
1. Understand domain, requirements and constraints.
2. Define layers (Domain, Application, Infrastructure, Presentation) and dependency direction.
3. Define projects/modules and namespaces per layer.
4. Identify cross-cutting concerns (DI, error handling, observability).
5. Choose patterns only where complexity justifies them.
6. Document key decisions and trade-offs.
7. Validate against `/ai-baseline/architecture.md`.
